featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited the D Mart store at Express Zone, Malad East yesterday and had a smooth and satisfying shopping experience. The store was well-organized, spacious, and neatly arranged, making it easy to find daily essentials, groceries, and household items. The shelves were well-stocked, and the pricing was very reasonable, which is one of the biggest advantages of shopping at D Mart.

The staff was helpful, and despite the store being busy, the billing counters were managed efficiently, keeping waiting time to a minimum. Overall, it’s a convenient and reliable place for budget-friendly shopping. I would definitely recommend this D Mart to anyone living nearby or visiting Express Zone.

featured_reviews.name: Tejaswini Manjarekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve always appreciated D-Mart for its efficiency and wide product range, but something that stood out during my recent visits was the management style of the store manager, Priyanka.

It’s quite clear she runs a tight ship—but perhaps a little too tight. I observed several instances where she spoke to her staff with an unnecessarily sharp tone. Whether it was a delay in restocking or a minor lapse in coordination, her response seemed to default to public scolding rather than constructive guidance. It was uncomfortable to watch, and I can only imagine how demotivating it must be for her team.

A store is only as good as the people who keep it running, and the team at this D-Mart works hard. But it’s hard to expect consistently great service when the manager creates a stressful and fear-driven environment. Leadership should inspire and support, not intimidate.

Priyanka clearly has authority, but what’s missing is empathy and emotional balance. I hope senior management takes note and offers her support in leadership training—because a calm, respectful atmosphere would benefit both the team and the customers alike.

featured_reviews.name: Strawberry Yt
featured_reviews.review_text:
I usually enjoy shopping at D-Mart due to its competitive prices and product variety. However, my recent experience was marred by the unprofessional behavior of the store manager Priya. The manager appeared visibly irritated, raised their voice unnecessarily, and responded rudely to the staff. This kind of behavior creates an uncomfortable shopping environment and reflects poorly on D-Mart’s reputation.

Employees seemed hesitant to approach the manager, possibly out of fear, which could point to deeper workplace issues. A retail environment should be built on respect and clear communication, especially from leadership. I hope D-Mart addresses this issue, as customer satisfaction and staff morale both depend on professional, calm management.

featured_reviews.name: Ashraf Morningstar
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience at Smart Sahakari Bhandar was very disappointing.
The store was poorly organized, and several shelves were either empty or cluttered. Product availability was inconsistent, and some items did not appear fresh. Basic grocery essentials were out of stock during my visit.
Staff behavior was unhelpful and inattentive. It was difficult to get assistance, and billing took longer than expected due to slow service.
Pricing was not competitive compared to nearby grocery stores, especially considering the overall experience.
Overall, the store needs significant improvement in stock management, cleanliness, and customer service. I would not recommend it based on my visit.

featured_reviews.name: Irfan Sayed
featured_reviews.review_text: Very poor crowd management. The store had huge rush and long waiting lines, but only 4 counters were working even though there are 6 counters available. Customers were standing for a long time without proper management or guidance. Staff looked unprepared to handle peak hours. Shopping became stressful instead of convenient. Management should open all counters during busy times and improve crowd handling Extremely disappointing experience. The store was overcrowded and chaotic, yet 2 billing counters were closed for no reason. People were stuck in long queues while staff moved slowly and there was no proper system to manage customers. If you know weekends and evenings are crowded, then why keep counters inactive? Poor planning and poor customer service Bad management during rush hours. The store was packed with customers and billing lines were very long, but only 4 out of 6 counters were operating. No crowd control, no quick response, and customers had to wait unnecessarily. Management seriously needs to improve operations because this kind of experience drives people away. Humanity invented supermarkets just to recreate traffic jams indoors. featured_reviews.name: JYOTI PRAJAPATI
featured_reviews.review_text:
Horrible Experience! Extremely Rude Staff (Mr. Vishal & Ajay ringe) and worst Management!

I had one of the worst shopping experiences of my life at Smart Sahakari Bhandar. I did grocery shopping worth ₹6200, and as per their own policy, customers should receive 1 kg of sugar for every ₹2500 spent. That clearly means I was entitled to 2 kg of sugar. However, after scanning all my items, the cashier casually told me there was no sugar available and completed the billing.

Later, I clearly saw sugar available at another counter and asked her to provide it since I had already crossed the billing amount. She bluntly refused, saying nothing could be done once the bill was generated. Absolutely ridiculous!

Then the store head, Vishal, came over and behaved extremely rudely and unprofessionally. Instead of resolving the issue, he started arguing with us as if we were begging for something free. He had no idea how to talk to customers and showed zero respect or accountability. We were made to stand there and argue for more than 30 minutes for a mistake that was entirely theirs.

Finally, after wasting so much of our time, he created a voucher, refunded the amount, and regenerated the bill. This entire drama could have been avoided if the staff and management had even basic customer-handling skills.

The staff here is arrogant, rude, and completely clueless about customer service. The management is pathetic and doesn’t know how to honor their own offers.
